description: Put a previous successful deployment of the linked Rebase Cloud project back into service (`rebase cloud rollback`). Production changes, so it needs `confirm: true`: the first call says what it would do. Without `deploymentId`, the most recent rollbackable deployment that is not the live one.

confirm.description: true once the user has agreed to exactly this. Without it the tool says what it would do and does nothing

deploymentId.description: The deployment to return to, from rebase_cloud_deployments_list

project.description: The project to act on: a registered project's name (rebase_project_list), or a Rebase Cloud project's slug or id. Optional when the session's directory is linked to the intended project. Refused when it names a different project than the directory's link.

name: rebase_cloud_rollback
